description: This file defines the LangText class, which handles language string translations, including retrieving text based on keys, modules, and language, as well as managing the use of global language arrays within SuiteCRM.

classes.name: LangText
classes.description: A class for managing language translations and string retrieval in SuiteCRM, supporting different translation sources and parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing translation parameters such as key, args, use case, module, language, and logging preferences.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Retrieves the localized text for the specified key, applying argument replacements and considering module and language overrides.

methods.name: resolveText
methods.description: Resolves the text string from global language arrays or module language files based on current settings.

methods.name: resolveTextByGlobals
methods.description: Resolves text using global arrays: app_strings, mod_strings, and app_list_strings, based on the use case.

methods.name: resolveTextByGlobal
methods.description: Helper function to retrieve specific string from a global array with fallback default.

methods.name: updateTextByModuleLang
methods.description: Attempts to get translation from module-specific language files if global lookup fails.

methods.name: replaceArgs
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in the string with provided arguments.

methods.name: selfUpdate
methods.description: Updates internal properties for key, args, and use case if new values are provided.

methods.name: getModuleLang
methods.description: Loads module-specific language strings using external LanguageManager class.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the translated text when object is treated as a string.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Static method to instantiate LangText and retrieve translated text in one call.
